source: GitHub workflow job logs retrieved through the connected GitHub tool

observed_failures_and_fixes.cause: Clean CI checkout intentionally lacks the multi-gigabyte restored baseline before unit tests.
observed_failures_and_fixes.fix: Bundle exact two audited lexical gzip resources (1,843,222 bytes total), validate stored SHA256, and reproduce using that small fallback. Store source identities as POSIX paths on all hosts.

observed_failures_and_fixes.error: UnicodeDecodeError from cp1252 while reading selected_languages.json
observed_failures_and_fixes.fix: Read the UTF-8 catalogue explicitly as UTF-8.

observed_failures_and_fixes.error: PackageError caused by Unsafe transaction directory
observed_failures_and_fixes.cause: Resolved long directory spelling compared against an unresolved Windows temporary-root alias.
observed_failures_and_fixes.fix: Resolve roots at both transaction recovery and locking boundaries; add portable relative-root regression.

observed_failures_and_fixes.error: Expected injected OSError was not raised
observed_failures_and_fixes.cause: Test injection compared resolved destination with unresolved Windows alias, so it never injected the write failure.
observed_failures_and_fixes.fix: Compare both destination paths after resolve(); preserve rollback assertions.

observed_failures_and_fixes.cause: ZipInfo constructor normalized the backslash to a slash when the fixture was built on Windows.
observed_failures_and_fixes.fix: Initial fixture fix sets raw ZipInfo.filename after construction. Follow-up run44986685686 exposed a second normalization while reading on Windows; the final fix validates ZipInfo.orig_filename in all archive validators. See windows_ci_failures_44986685686.json.

follow_up: Run44986685686: Linux unit tests passed; Windows retained one raw-ZIP-name failure, subsequently fixed. Actual Windows speech/NVDA probes had not executed in either failed run.
